reason: Bootstrapping work is about to run through ADR-006 coding workspaces with OpenRouter's free stealth model Ox Alpha, but AI_AVAILABLE_MODELS did not offer it, so a chat turn could not select it. The initial local edit also flipped ENABLE_CODING's code default to True, which crashed the running dev backend on its own startup guard and would fail CI the same way, since CI boots from the placeholder .env.example with no sandbox token - so the flag stays default-off in code and dev enablement moves to the environment, which is what the guard was designed to demand.
risks: Ox Alpha's function calling has not been exercised against the approval-gated coding toolkit; a model that fumbles deferred-approval tool calls will read as the assistant being broken
rollback: git revert removes the model from the list. Outside the repository and untouched by a revert: backend/.env (gitignored) now carries SANDBOX_SERVICE_TOKEN and ENABLE_CODING=true for this dev machine; the app image was rebuilt twice (first to pick up the pydantic-ai-backend dependency the old image predated, then from corrected source); the adr006-smoke sandbox session was created and stopped.
security_impact: One new model id is offered for per-turn selection: stealth/ox-alpha, routed through the existing OpenRouterProvider path with no new tool, permission, or network surface. The provider behind the stealth slug is anonymous and the preview is free, so prompt and completion retention must be assumed: coding turns will carry repository content (public), chat and RAG content (not necessarily public) to that provider - a standing caution, not a code property. ENABLE_CODING stays default-off in code; dev enablement lives in the gitignored backend/.env alongside the sandbox token, and the startup guard that demands the token was exercised for real this session - the initial default-flip crash-looped the dev backend exactly as the guard intends.
summary: Offer the Ox Alpha stealth model for coding-workspace turns, keeping coding enablement environment-scoped
